title: 第22章 泰山压顶
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
月光从窗棂洒进来，照亮了两个人的脸。

    林曦一身黑裙，长发垂落肩头，五官冷艳得像画里走出来的仙子。

    但此刻，她直接施法，定住了陆沉。

    魅姬站在她身后，布置了一个结界。

    “陆沉啊。”

    “我来跟你商量个事情！”

    陆沉被禁锢，只能用眼神示意。

    “你要问什么事？”

    魅姬自问自答，走到他的跟前。

    “其实也没有什么事，就是找你借个东西而已……”

    陆沉的瞳孔骤然收缩。

    他挣扎着想说话，林曦却不同意。

    只不过，她也还在轻轻发抖。

    显然，这娘们也是头一回做这种事。

    “你……你别动！”

    林曦的声音带着一丝颤抖。

    “我们……我们不会伤害你的！”

    “对呀对呀。”

    魅姬接话，然后从袖子里摸出一个小小的玉瓶。

    “就取一点，很快的。”

    陆沉看着那个玉瓶，又看看面前这两个女人，脑子里一片空白。

    他怀疑自己最近是被什么脏东西缠住了，遇到的每一件事都是这么逆天。

    他想起白天魅姬踩在他小腿上的时候。

    想起她威胁自己时，那个意味深长的眼神。

    他忽然明白了什么。

    这个世界的女人估计都被降智了！

    所以，她们老是有一些奇奇怪怪的想法，一定是这样！

    “唔唔唔！！”陆沉想开口，却开不了口。

    林曦的手在发抖，但按得很紧。

    她别过头，不看他的眼睛，耳根红得像要滴血。

    魅姬倒是镇定得很，俯下身来，脸凑到陆沉面前。

    但灯却汹涌，压的陆沉想要生气。

    “陆沉弟弟，你别怕，我们又不会吃了你。”

    她看了林曦一眼。

    “师姐，你松手吧，我相信他不会喊的，不然……”

    林曦犹豫了一下，慢慢松开了手。
content_en:
Moonlight poured in from the window lattice, illuminating the faces of the two people.

Lin Xi was dressed in a black dress, with long hair hanging down her shoulders, and her facial features were as cold as a fairy walking out of a painting.

But at this moment, she cast a spell directly and immobilized Lu Chen.

Mei Ji stood behind her and arranged a barrier.

"Lu Chen."

"I'm here to discuss something with you!"

Lu Chen was imprisoned and could only indicate with his eyes.

"What do you want to ask?"

Meiji asked herself questions and walked up to him.

"Actually, it's nothing, I just want to borrow something from you..."

Lu Chen's pupils suddenly shrank.

He struggled to speak, but Lin Xi disagreed.

However, she was still trembling slightly.

Obviously, this is the first time this girl has done this kind of thing.

"You...don't move!"

Lin Xi's voice was trembling.

"We...we won't hurt you!"

"Yes, yes."

Mei Ji answered and took out a small jade bottle from her sleeve.

"Just take a little, it'll be quick."

Lu Chen looked at the jade bottle and then at the two women in front of him, his mind went blank.

He suspected that he had been entangled in something dirty recently, and everything he encountered was so unnatural.

He remembered when Mei Ji stepped on his calf during the day.

Thinking of that meaningful look in her eyes when she threatened him.

He suddenly understood something.

All the women in this world have probably been deceived!

Therefore, they always have some weird ideas, that must be it!

"Uh huh!!" Lu Chen wanted to speak, but couldn't.

Lin Xi's hands were shaking, but she pressed them tightly.

She turned her head away, not looking into his eyes, and her ears were as red as if they were bleeding.

Mei Ji was very calm, and she leaned down and put her face in front of Lu Chen.

But the lights were surging, which made Lu Chen want to be angry.

"Brother Lu Chen, don't be afraid, we won't eat you."

She glanced at Lin Xi.

"Sister, please let go. I believe he won't shout, otherwise..."

Lin Xi hesitated for a moment and slowly let go of her hand.
